alternatives.option: Trust a caller-supplied evidence_class and audit it later
alternatives.reason_rejected: the audit would be an instruction, not a wall; the field measured that instruction-only gates leak

alternatives.option: Decide class in the engine from the record type
alternatives.reason_rejected: the same record type (a decision) legitimately arrives as proposal from MCP and as human_statement from an adapter; only the ingress knows

context: Wrote the v3 foundation ADR (docs/adr/2026-09-foundation-contracts.md, PROPOSED) and executable contracts in src/contracts (event envelope, canonical digest, ids, evidence classes, scope algebra, lifecycle payloads, delivery states, Ed25519 signing, ingress validation); 21 contract tests green, tsc clean.
rationale: R03/R17 forbid caller-controlled actor/active/promoted_by fields from establishing authority; the 2.x gap 6 is exactly that. Putting the class decision in validateEvent (pure, per ingress) makes every path enforce the same boundary and makes a forged ruling a schema-level rejection (CLASS_NOT_ALLOWED_ON_INGRESS / SIGNATURE_REQUIRED / SIGNATURE_INVALID) rather than a label.
summary: Evidence class is decided by the INGRESS that produced the event (ceremony/adapter/connector/mcp/cli/import/migration), validated before storage, never taken from a caller field; human_ruling is producible only by the signing ceremony or an import carrying a valid signature by a known HUMAN key
